models.name: v-model
models.description:
A `GroupValidityEvent` object containing:

  `isValid`: the aggregated validity of underlying components

  `componentsWithError`: a list of components with errors sorted in DOM order

  `componentCount`: number of registered components

props.name: stopPropagation
props.description: Controls whether component-validity event should be propagated or not from underlying components.

events.name: group-validity
events.description: Emitted when validation group has been updated.
